privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta: Last updated: October 2026 · Valid across all Donorfit European platforms

info.heading: 1. Information on the Collection of Personal Data
paragraphs: The protection of personal data is of utmost importance to Donorfit. Below we inform you about the collection of personal data when using our website and platform in accordance with the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and national data protection laws.
Personal data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person (e.g., name, address, email addresses, IP address, user behavior).

under Article 28 GDPR. A formal Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is executed with every client organization.

website.heading: 4. Data Processing on This Marketing Website
paragraphs: When you visit our website for informational purposes only, we collect only the personal data that your browser transmits to our server (server log files), including IP address, date and time of request, time zone difference to GMT, content of request, HTTP status code, and browser type. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in delivering website stability and security).

When you submit an inquiry form (e.g., booking a demo or requesting onboarding), data submitted (name, organization name, email, country, message) is processed under Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR for the purpose of taking steps prior to entering into a contract.

storage.heading: 5. Storage Location and Data Security
paragraphs: All customer databases and web services are hosted exclusively in European data centers located in Frankfurt, Germany and Dublin, Ireland. We utilize TLS 1.3 encryption in transit and AES-256 encryption at rest.

rights.heading: 6. Rights of Data Subjects
paragraphs: You have the right to request access to your personal data (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), and data portability (Art. 20 GDPR). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.meta: Clear explanations of how Donorfit utilizes cookies and local storage

what.heading: 1. What are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your computer or mobile device when you access websites. They allow web applications to identify your browser session, remember preferences, and ensure secure authentication.

items.name: Strictly Necessary Cookies
items.description: Required for core platform security, anti-CSRF token verification, and session state. These cookies do not store personally identifiable marketing information and cannot be disabled.

items.name: Functional & Preference Cookies
items.description: Remember your chosen language, selected currency, and form field progress.

items.name: Privacy-Centric Analytics Cookies
items.description: Collect aggregated, anonymized insights regarding page load speeds, popular guides, and donation completion rates. These cookies are never set without your prior affirmative consent.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.meta: Governing nonprofit platform access, payment processing, and usage rights

sections.heading: 1. Scope of Application
paragraphs: These Terms & Conditions govern the provision of software-as-a-service (SaaS) fundraising and donor management software by Donorfit to non-governmental organizations, registered charities, foundations, and non-profit associations.

sections.heading: 2. Service Description
paragraphs: Donorfit provides software tools for online donation collection, recurring giving management, sponsorship administration, money pool coordination, membership management, and donor CRM records. Donorfit does not act as a bank or custodial escrow provider; all financial transactions are executed through authorized payment service providers directly to the nonprofit’s merchant accounts.

sections.heading: 3. Nonprofit Obligations
paragraphs: Nonprofits warrant that they possess legal authorization to conduct fundraising activities under applicable local legislation and that all published campaign details, beneficiary descriptions, and tax receipt representations are truthful and accurate.

sections.heading: 4. Data Ownership & Availability
paragraphs: The nonprofit retains exclusive ownership of all donor and contribution records. Donorfit undertakes to maintain a 99.9% target system availability, excluding scheduled maintenance.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.meta: Our commitment to inclusive, barrier-free digital fundraising

conformance.heading: 1. Conformance Target
conformance.before: Donorfit is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone and apply the relevant accessibility standards targeting the
conformance.bold: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA

measures.heading: 2. Measures Taken
items: Semantic HTML elements (`header`, `main`, `nav`, `section`, `article`, `footer`) throughout our architecture.
High color contrast ratios exceeding 4.5:1 for standard body text and 3:1 for large display elements.
Full keyboard navigation capability with visible focus outlines (`focus-visible`).
Accessible forms with explicit labels, aria-attributes, and meaningful validation feedback.
Dignified descriptive alt-text attributes on all photographic and illustrative assets.
